messages:
mike: quick ping — can someone take a look at PR #9082? it's a small change that adds streaming backpressure handling to the client and moves the session token into request metadata. aiming to merge before tomorrow's deploy window.

sara: looking now. is the API change backward compatible for existing SDK users?

mike: good q — yes, it's additive. server still accepts the token in the body for one release, but we want clients to start sending it in metadata: `x-session-token`. added a compatibility layer.

jess: skimmed the code — looks OK but CI failed on one flaky stream test. throwing the log here: ```
FAIL test_stream_consume_backpressure.py::test_unbuffered_consumer - AssertionError: expected 3 calls, got 4
Traceback...
```

oliver: I hit that locally too. flaky timing. I added a small sleep in the test to stabilize in my branch. thinking we should instead use the `event.wait()` pattern to avoid sleeps.

mike: agree, please push a fix to the test in the PR. also added a note in the PR description for QA about Dedicated mode behavior.

sara: I can do a review pass after the test fix. @jess can you push the test change?

jess: pushing in 5. removing the sleep and using `consumer.ready.wait(timeout=2)` instead. re-ran `pytest -q tests/stream` locally and it's green.

ci-bot: build/9082 #42 — tests: failing -> running after patch...

mike: thanks. once green, can one of you add an approval? I want to merge before the 09:00 deploy window.

oliver: I'll take final 👀 after CI passes. if green and no regressions on compatibility tests, I'll approve.

sara: noted, will look for compatibility smoke on staging once it's deployed to the canary slot. ping me when merged so I can kick off the canary run. :thumbsup:

mike: perfect — tagging this as high-priority for the morning. thanks all!
